info.title: Chillax - Spaces HTTP API
info.description: The Spaces Microservice HTTP API for rooms, tables, reservations and session management

get.description: Get all PlayStation rooms with their current display status

post.description: Create a new PlayStation room (Admin only)

get.description: Get a specific room by its ID

put.description: Update room name, description, and rates (Admin only)

get.description: Get only rooms that are currently available for reservation

put.description: Update the physical status of a room (Admin only)

post.description: Create an immediate reservation for a room. Customer has 15 minutes to arrive before auto-cancellation.
Start the timer for a reserved session (Admin only)
End the session and calculate cost (Admin only)
Cancel a reservation or active session (Admin only)
Start a walk-in session without an assigned customer (Admin only)

put.description: Change the player mode (Single/Multi) for an active session (Admin only)

post.description: Leave a session you've joined (cannot leave if you're the owner)
Cancel your own reservation (only if still in Reserved status)

get.description: Get all sessions for the current authenticated user
Get all currently active sessions (Admin only)

post.summary: Assign a customer to a walk-in session
post.description: Assign a customer to an active walk-in session that has no owner (Admin only)

post.summary: Add a member to a session
post.description: Add a customer as a member to an active session (Admin only)

delete.summary: Remove a member from a session
delete.description: Remove a non-owner member from an active session (Admin only)

get.description: Get a specific session by its ID
Get completed sessions history for a specific room (Admin only)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sessions to return

get.description: Get completed/cancelled sessions across all rooms, paginated (Admin only)
Per-day and per-room hours/sessions/revenue over completed sessions (Admin only)

parameters.name: tzOffsetMinutes
parameters.description: JS getTimezoneOffset() of the caller, for local-day bucketing

get.description: Get room info and active session status for QR code scan-to-join

post.description: Join the active session of a room (via QR scan)
